title: Halloween Home Safety Checklist: Preparing for Trick-or-Treaters
summary: Follow these Halloween safety tips to keep your front yard and walkways safe for trick-or-treaters and other guests.
body_markdown:
Need some gear to keep your home safe this Halloween? Consider picking up one or more of these cameras to help.


**Outdoor camera:** The[Arlo Pro 6th Gen](https://us.arlo.com/products/arlo-pro-6) includes a ton of powerful features that make it a great fit for installing anywhere around the house. 2K video with High Dynamic Range provides impressive clarity, while the 160° Field of View ensures nothing gets missed. Plus, the camera includes an Integrated Spotlight, making it a great way to capture details in the dark and keep areas lit.


**Floodlight:** Need a dedicated night vision security camera for your walkways and driveways? Pick up either the[Arlo Wired Floodlight](https://us.arlo.com/products/arlo-wired-floodlight) or[Arlo Pro 3 Wireless Floodlight](https://us.arlo.com/products/arlo-pro-3-floodlight-camera) depending on your setup and security needs. Get up to 3000 lumens of brightness with the Arlo Pro 3 Wireless Floodlight when connected to the Outdoor Magnetic Charging Cable. It’s a perfect choice for illuminating everything you need to keep trick-or-treaters safe on Halloween.


**Doorbell:** Stay on top of every ring of the doorbell with the[Arlo Video Doorbell](https://us.arlo.com/products/arlo-doorbell) . Receive notifications on your smartphone whenever it rings, and stay connected with guests with built-in 2-Way Audio.
